name: ClipMaker
description: Trims a YouTube video down to a chosen time range, hands back the full transcript as a file, and adds a brief summary of the strongest moment. Useful when the transcript matters as much as the cut; you supply the timestamps.

official.title: ClipMaker by Luigi
official.description: Cuts YouTube videos to a time range and returns full transcripts as a file, plus a short TLDR of the best take. For anyone who wants clips and captions...
